periods.label: 凛奈的女仆翻译

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

periods.species: human (not a Blazer in this passage)

status.current: attends the banquet as Rinna's servant, not as a tournament representative

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress; Charlotte translates Rinna's theatrical speech into ordinary meaning.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Carries Sara away after Shizuku knocks her out.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Politely greets him but becomes jealous when Rinna talks about hiring him.

periods.summary: Charlotte accompanies Rinna at the banquet and clarifies that she is Rinna's personal maid rather than a representative student. She translates Rinna's exaggerated declarations into plain language, carries the unconscious Sara away, and shows subtle jealousy when Rinna tries to recruit Ikki as a butler.

key_events.summary: Introduces herself and removes Sara from the hall.
